messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot align system reserves with supplier payments or internal spreadsheets, leading to data discrepancies. This forces teams to perform manual reconciliation work and creates uncertainty about how to correctly update figures.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4130",
   "similarity": 0.051,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now provides a clearer, more detailed payment history view, helping users track transactions, refunds, and adjustments with improved timestamps and categorization for faster reconciliation.\", \"id\": 4130, \"name\": \"Payment history improvements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4136",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater is updating its supplier address fields to support international formats and improve data validation, ensuring accurate claim processing across global regions.\", \"id\": 4136, \"name\": \"Supplier address fields\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4131",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.\", \"id\": 4131, \"name\": \"Workspace administration\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.033,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users cannot align system reserves with supplier payments or internal spreadsheets, forcing manual reconciliation. The most similar story, #4130 'Payment history improvements' (completed 2026-09-15), improves transaction tracking and categorization 'for faster reconciliation,' but it addresses viewing payment history, not aligning reserves with supplier payments or spreadsheets. The other stories (#4127, #4136, #4131, #4129) cover bulk document upload, supplier address fields, workspace administration, and supplier contact details — none address reserve alignment or reconciliation of figures. No roadmap items appear in the evidence. The core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
